name: Carver
source:
A rude, cheap little jerk who is quite self conscious-about his height. He can be found trying to swindle people out of pretty much anything in their pockets, and/or finding excuses to make a mess in Ginger's shop.

[From [url=https://gourmetvisual.itch.io/heartbaked]itch.io[/url]]
